problem:
Let $R=PQ.$ What is the value of ${r}_{25}$, if

$$
P=[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 \\ 3 & -4 \\ 4 & -6 \\ 1 & -8 \\ 3 & -9\end{aligned}],\,Q=[\begin{aligned}0 & 1 & 2 & -1 & 10 \\ 2 & 0 & 5 & -2 & 7\end{aligned}]?
$$

feedback.problem:
Let $D=AB.$ What is the value of ${d}_{24}$, if

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}-1 & 2 & 4 \\ 3 & 4 & -1 \\ -1 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 4 & -7\end{aligned}],\,B=[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & -2 & -3 \\ 0 & 4 & -1 & 1 \\ 2 & 0 & 3 & -3\end{aligned}]?
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
Multiplying the $2$nd row in $A$ by the $4$th column in $B$, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{d}_{24} & =[\begin{aligned}-1 & 2 & 4 \\ 3 & 4 & -1 \\ -1 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 4 & -7\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & -2 & -3 \\ 0 & 4 & -1 & 1 \\ 2 & 0 & 3 & -3\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}3 & 4 & -1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 1 \\ -3\end{aligned}] \\  & =3\cdot (-3)+4\cdot 1+(-1)\cdot (-3) \\  & =-9+4+3 \\  & =-2.\end{aligned}
$$
